# Method: each exact product's link was read off the plan page (local production build of the preview branch), then its listing was checked by ASIN with a web search limited to amazon.com, because Amazon blocks AI agents from its pages. Snapshots are undated and not location-aware: they can confirm the product, the variant and the pack size, and sometimes an offer; they cannot confirm live stock. A search link lands on results by design and is not evidence of stock.
